meta.title: Ask in sidebar
meta.description: Ask questions about text you select in an assistant answer, answered in an ephemeral right-side panel from a snapshot of the main conversation. Select text inside an assistant answer and click the Ask in Sidebar button. The panel header chooses how much main context to reuse (full, last 20, last 6, or quote only), answers can be stopped, copied or regenerated, and the discussion stays in memory only: it cannot call tools or modify the workspace.
